design.split: 60% development / 15% validation / 25% final test, by time
design.note: All Week 11 choices were made on validation data; the final test was run once.

leakage_checks.check: Time order: development < validation < final test
History features use only earlier transactions (hours since previous > 0)
Transactions in prior 24h never exceed prior transaction count
Fraud label is not a predictor
No single predictor separates fraud almost perfectly (AUC < 0.90)
leakage_checks.detail: strongest single predictor: IEEE count C4 (anonymized), AUC 0.679

leakage_caveats: Alert-rule thresholds (Week 9) were percentiles of the full period, so the rule-score baseline carries slight look-ahead; the fraud model does not use the rule score.
C and D variables are anonymized by the data provider; their timing cannot be verified independently. They are treated as recorded at transaction time, as documented by the provider.

development.model: Candidate: + more IEEE attributes (D10-D14, email, card network)

selection.rule: Keep candidate if validation capture@50 (expected exposure) improves by >= 0.5 points; otherwise keep the Week 10 specification.
selection.decision: Validation capture at 50 reviews/day: Week 10 35.5%, candidate 37.2% (+1.6 points). Rule: keep the candidate only if the gain is at least 0.5 points. Selected: Candidate: + more IEEE attributes (D10-D14, email, card network).

leakage_checks.check: Time order: development < validation < final test days
Predictors are known the evening before (lagged counts only)
leakage_checks.detail: yesterday, two days ago, same weekday last week, previous 7-day average, weekday, trend

leakage_caveats: Alert counts come from rules whose thresholds were set on the full period; this is a slight look-ahead in the target series itself.

development.model: Candidate: + alerts two days ago and same weekday last week

selection.rule: Keep candidate if validation MAE falls by >= 2%; otherwise keep Week 10.
selection.decision: Validation MAE: Week 10 13.8, candidate 13.9 (0.5% higher). Rule: keep the candidate only if MAE falls by at least 2%. Selected: Week 10 model (yesterday, 7-day average, weekday, trend).
